players.product: Ethernet switch chips: 12.8T / 25.6T flagship chips (up to 800G ports) for large-scale data centers and cloud, TsingMa.MX 2.4T and GoldenGate 1.2T series, plus switch-chip modules and Ethernet switches

quarterly_data.quarter: Centec Communications results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Director and general manager Sun Jianyong (H1 2026 results briefing): Q2 2026 gross margin was 40.75%, down 8.70% quarter on quarter, mainly because of the product sales mix and because the fast development of the global intelligent-computing industry disturbed the supply chain, putting product costs under temporary pressure; the company will keep optimising the supply chain for its core products.

quarterly_data.quarter: Centec Communications results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: General manager Sun Jianyong (results briefing): the RMB 22 hundred million figure is the daily related-party transaction cap the company raised on August 7, 2026, an upper-limit forecast based on potential contracts and orders covering its full range of chip products - not an actual contract amount and not a revenue forecast; actual 2026 revenue from sales to related parties will be below the cap, and it is not a forecast or commitment for 2026 or later years.
quarterly_data.figure: related-party transaction cap RMB 22 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Centec Communications results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Lyu Baoli (results briefing): core Ethernet switch chips are the main and a rising share of revenue; Ethernet switches are a supporting business that enriches the chips' downstream ecosystem and gathers feedback for later chip generations. The E781-64C switch, built around the company's new-generation core chip, is in early market introduction. The 12.8T/25.6T products have entered the application stage at customers, and the company is pushing R&D of its next-generation high-end product for large data centers and cloud.
